title: Undo in reverse
description:
Make a driver's unload undo everything its entry did, in reverse order, even when entry fails halfway.

```
DriverEntry: create device ok, create link ok, register callback FAILED
  -> undo: delete link, delete device
  -> return the failure; nothing left behind
DriverUnload after a good start: unregister callback, delete link, delete device
```
hints: Push a step onto `done` only after `run()` returned true (lesson 1.04).
`for (auto it{done.rbegin()}; it != done.rend(); ++it) (*it)->undo();` undoes in reverse.
requirements: Each step has a "do" and an "undo"; a cleanup stack records the steps that succeeded.
On a failure, run the undos of the successful steps from last to first and return the error.
Unload runs every undo in reverse.
stretch: Write the same with a C++ RAII guard per step and compare.
